card.name: Math and science measurement text
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation in math or science explanations about scales, units, size or measure, such as 'in' after 'often used', or 'that' after 'the fact'. It fires on the word just before a technical term is expected.

modes.label: Linking words in unit and scale talk
modes.description: A small word such as in, of or on within text about temperature scales or angle units.
modes.example: The Kelvin scale is a temperature scale that is often used<< in>> astronomy and space science.

modes.label: Set size and measure theory
modes.description: Punctuation or linking words in text about cardinality, infinity or measure of sets.
modes.example: In measure theory<<,>> one sometimes defines the "extended reals
